text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position in opening sentence and repeated stance throughout","quality":"stance clarity","description":"The essay states its claim plainly and keeps returning to the same side without wavering."},{"evidence":"because people will pay less attention to the road ... lead to more car accidents","quality":"causal reasoning","description":"It explains a chain of cause and effect rather than only making assertions."},{"evidence":"whose fault will it be ... driver or the manufacturer","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"It raises a real dispute from the article and uses it to strengthen the argument against driverless cars."},{"evidence":"So, they might not even know the car needs them to be alert","quality":"practical audience awareness","description":"The essay considers how ordinary buyers may misunderstand the technology in practice."},{"evidence":"What if in twenty years ... some will lack driving skills","quality":"future consequence development","description":"It extends the argument into longer-term social consequences instead of stopping at immediate effects."},{"evidence":"No one should waste so much money on a project that has a possibility of failing","quality":"conclusion strength","description":"The ending restates the judgment forcefully and gives the argument a more decisive close."}]}
